function: Joint learned control of mobile-AP movement (up/down/left/right) and downlink power (AP-level and antenna-level) to maximize sum spectral efficiency in cell-free mMIMO (pp. 4, 7).
system: Downlink cell-free mMIMO (TDD, MR precoding): M UAV-concept mobile-APs with N antennas (8 default), K single-antenna UEs, 20 MHz; no RIS; carrier not stated (pp. 3-4, 9).
method: Multi-agent reinforcement learning SF-MADDPG: permutation-based hypernetwork actor, GNN-aided communication, attention-based intrinsic reward and mixed critic; trained over episodes (pp. 6-8).
data_channel: Custom simulation: correlated Rayleigh fading, COST 321 Walfish-Ikegami path loss, APs and UEs random in a 1x1 km2 square with wrap-around; no dataset or measurements (pp. 3, 9).
test_conditions: Training and test settings not distinguished; results for sweeps of M, K, N and CDFs of sum SE; no test in unseen conditions reported (pp. 9-11).
baselines: Non-learned: fractional power control, 'Random' and 'Random + Fractional' (Figs. 6-7); learned: MADDPG, Pe-MADDPG, Co-MADDPG, AIRMN, LIIR, MDGNN 1D/2D/3D (p. 9).
metrics: Sum spectral efficiency (CDF and averages), convergence episodes, mobile-AP trajectories (Fig. 5), relative SE gains in percent, observation dimension order (pp. 9-12).
complexity: None for computation: only observation dimension O((K+L)L!+(NK)K!) reduced to O(L+(NK)K!), and 'comparable' complexity to MADDPG stated qualitatively (p. 12); Table III absent from file.
q1_support: p. 3: "modeled through correlated Rayleigh fading"; p. 9: "The pathloss model is computed by the COST 321 Walfish-Ikegami model"; custom simulator with only the path loss from a standard model, no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, or measured channel.
q2_support: p. 9: "we can also introduce an online learning mechanism in the proposed framework" is only suggested, not tested; pp. 10-11 (Figs. 9-12) sweep M, K, N with no statement of training on one setting and testing on another.
q3_support: p. 9: "Fractional [17]" (heuristic) and "MARL-based schemes: Permutation-based MADDPG (Pe-MADDPG) [29]" plus Co-MADDPG, AIRMN, LIIR, MADDPG, MDGNN; p. 10: SF-MADDPG "yields a 45.97%, 25.29%, 18.79%, and 14.41% improvement in sum SE" and beats fractional power control by 81.63%.
q4_support: p. 12: "reducing its observation dimension" from O((K+L)L!+(NK)K!) to O(L+(NK)K!) is an input-space order, and cost is only "comparable to conventional MADDPG"; Table III is cited but absent from the file; no FLOPs, parameter count, or runtime.
q5_support: p. 9: "the simulation works are conducted with an Nvidia GeForce GTX 3060 Graphics Processing Unit"; no code or data link anywhere, and the channels are simulated.
notes: PDF is the arXiv preprint v1 (arXiv:2412.02581, 3 Dec 2024), no DOI printed; topic and IEEE TWC format are consistent; Tables I and III are cited in the text but missing from the file. Area 6 chosen because the mobile-APs are UAVs (aerial links, p. 2) and the learned decisions are power control (physical layer) jointly with AP placement; if the reviewer treats the system as terrestrial cell-free, area 3 would apply. q1: only the path loss follows COST (written COST 321); small-scale fading is correlated Rayleigh. q4 is borderline: the observation-dimension orders on p. 12 are not an operations, parameter, or runtime count.
